lines.translation: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Sing the songs of Praise of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat param sukh paaeeai aavaa gaun mitai mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is obtained; coming and going is ended, my friend. ||1||Pause||
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is enlightened,
and comes to dwell in His lotus feet. ||1||
In the Society of the Saints, one is saved.
O Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||57||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:
My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jap sadaa suhele sagal binaase rog kooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, I am always at peace; all my illness and fraud is dispelled. ||1||Pause||
Worship and adore that One Lord alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee saran sadaa sukh hoi ||1||
lines.translation: In His Sanctuary, eternal peace is obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: need suhelee naam kee laagee bhookh ||
lines.translation: One who feels hunger for the Naam sleeps in peace.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all pains are dispelled. ||2||
Enjoy celestial bliss, O my Siblings of Destiny.
The Perfect Guru has eradicated all anxiety. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar prabh kaa jap jaap ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, chant God's Chant.
O Nanak, He Himself shall save you. ||4||2||58||
Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I humbly bow to the Lord, the Supreme Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਨ ਥਲਨ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨ ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jalan thalan basudh gagan ek eka(n)kaara(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The One, the One and Only Creator Lord permeates the water, the land, the earth and the sky. ||1||Pause||
Over and over again, the Creator Lord destroys, sustains and creates.
He has no home; He needs no nourishment. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)bheer dheer naam heer ooch mooch apaara(n) ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is deep and profound, strong, poised, lofty, exalted and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕੇਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: karan kel gun amol naanak balihaara(n) ||2||1||59||
lines.translation: He stages His plays; His Virtues are priceless. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||59||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਭੋਗ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: roop ra(n)g suga(n)dh bhog tiaag chale maaiaa chhale kanik kaaminee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You must abandon your beauty, pleasures, fragrances and enjoyments; beguiled by gold and sexual desire, you must still leave Maya behind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਰਬ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)daar darab arab kharab pekh leelaa man sadhaarai ||
lines.translation: You gaze upon billions and trillions of treasures and riches, which delight and comfort your mind,
but these will not go along with you. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਮਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sut kalatr bhraat meet urajh pario bharam mohio ih birakh chhaamanee ||
lines.translation: Entangled with children, spouse, siblings and friends, you are enticed and fooled; these pass like the shadow of a tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saran naanak sukh sa(n)t bhaavanee ||2||2||60||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His lotus feet; He has found peace in the faith of the Saints. ||2||2||60||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man ot lehu har naamaa ||
lines.translation: O mind, take the sheltering support of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simaran duramat naasai paavahi pad nirabaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, evil-mindedness is dispelled, and the state of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: badabhaagee tih jan kau jaanahu jo har ke gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Know that one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke paap khoi kai phun baiku(n)th sidhaavai ||1||
lines.translation: The sins of countless incarnations are washed off, and he attains the heavenly realm. ||1||
